# The Most Expensive DC Movie Ever Made (And Why It Cost So Much To Make)
Attempting to replicate the financial success and pop-cultural juggernaut of Marvel Studios' 2012 film " [The Avengers](https://www.slashfilm.com/565356/the-avengers-revisited-road-to-endgame/) ," Warner Bros.

...

## $300 million
Warner Bros.
A budget of $300 million would make "Justice League" the fifth most expensive movie ever made behind "Avengers: Endgame," "Avengers: Age of Ultron," and "Avengers: Infinity War." The most expensive film ever made is "Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides," which cost $379 million.

...

The only reference point audiences have the is 2020 [four-hour version of "Justice League"](https://www.slashfilm.com/579873/zack-snyders-justice-league-review/) which required an additional $70 million to complete.

...

## Inflation
Thanks to blockbuster trends that started in the 1990s, studio tentpoles are expected to have giant price tags. We can blame James Cameron for that, as his 1994 film "True Lies" was the first film to cost more than $100m, and his 1997 film "Titanic" was the first to top $200m.

...

Even adjusted for inflation, only two of the 20 most expensive films of all time were made before 2000: "Titanic" and "Waterworld" (which cost $322 million and $292 million, adjusted). Of the 100 most expensive films of all time, only two — "Cleopatra" in 1964 and "Superman" in 1978 — were made before 1995.
